name: economicsapi
description: Find and retrieve economics, trade, FX, commodities and yields with common names and dated values.

interface.longDescription:
Get the latest macroeconomic, trade, commodity and FX data in ChatGPT. Explore government bond yields, compare countries, review historical trends and get economic forecasts.

Ask a question and EconomicsAPI finds the data, with dates and units.

Connect your EconomicsAPI account to get started. Setup instructions: https://docs.economicsapi.com/chatgpt.
defaultPrompt: Find inflation in Mexico and show its latest value and history since 2020.
Show available EUR/USD rates, gold prices and Canadian government bond yields.
Show Germany’s coffee exports to France in 2023, with values in USD.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of EconomicsAPI for ChatGPT, with economic indicators, trade data, exchange rates, commodity prices, government bond yields and economic forecasts.
